# coval_agents (Data Source)

Retrieves all Coval agents matching public API filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_agents" "production" {
  filter      = "model_type=MODEL_TYPE_CHAT"
  tag_filters = ["production"]
  order_by    = "display_name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional public API filter expression. Quote values that contain spaces.
- `order_by` (String) Public API sort expression, such as -create_time or display_name.
- `page_size` (Number) Number of agents requested per API page. The data source follows all returned pages.
- `tag_filters` (Set of String) Tags every returned agent must contain.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) All matching agent summaries. Use the singular coval_agent data source to retrieve free-form JSON fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
